skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply decision-making processes in management.
Utilize tools and techniques for analyzing data to support decision-making.
Develop and interpret models that support decision-making processes.
Apply simulation techniques to support decision-making scenarios.
Conduct regression analysis to predict outcomes and inform decisions.
Use forecasting methods to anticipate future trends and make informed decisions.
Formulate and solve linear programming problems to optimize decision-making.
Construct and utilize decision trees to evaluate different decision options.
Implement business intelligence systems to enhance decision-making capabilities.
